links.description: Mappings turn a partner's fields into a lead; idempotency keys hold each request's saved answer. The partner API's limits live in Tatva Setup, under Platform.
links.label: Partner API

links.description: Load leads from a file through a mapping. Each row's result is kept on the import job.
links.label: Bulk Import

links.description: Intake forms take leads from web pages into a chosen grain. The settings control who may submit.
links.label: Web Intake

links.description: Each Facebook lead form needs a sync source tied to the app whose token reads it. Meta Datasets send stage changes back to Meta as conversions.
links.label: Meta
